encoding: Ordinal bin ID 0..n-1; one affine transform fitted on reference training rows only matches mean/std of continuous control training labels. Same frozen transform for old-label sensitivity; no CSRankNorm or daily reranking after grading.
sample_protocol: Exact H20 training indices, original rank-before-date-selection and legacy-h40-base-v1; no sample/intersection changes.
evaluation: Canonical official_head_from_preds; five-seed daily zscore mean, Top3xH5 net_ann/net_ann_vol/net_sharpe, globalH5RankIC, years/styles; retain individual seeds as diagnostics.
sensitivity: All five seeds per new n. Refit old-label treatment only when encoded float32 target differs; exact input identity is a reuse diagnostic, not an independent replicate.
diagnostics: full early-stop curves and tree counts
Top3/Top5 tie frequency and seed agreement
paired old/new heads and metric differences on common frozen inputs
decision_rule: No automatic promotion. Compare each n against same-source continuous H20 and prior n5/n10. Report non-monotonicity, plateau/interior or endpoint optima separately for net_ann/Sharpe and sensitivity, including all tied maxima. Historical selection window, not independent OOS.
entry_policy: One new study entry linked to the closed label-grading campaign. Six internal n candidates with separate receipt/attempt/fit costs; native parent lifecycle plus exact fit ledger. Platform representative n7 is predeclared, not winner or aggregate.
implementation: Task-local adapters call existing trainer, evaluator, registry and report; no new permanent module or platform structure.

timing_estimate.hard_stop_new_fit_rule: Remaining time must cover fit plus 45min closeout; new whole candidate also reserves canonical evaluation. Budget can stop unstarted/partial candidates truthfully.
